I tap on Sana’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.

lines.en: It’s not something I do often. But it’s something (among many things) that I’d like to change about my life going forward.

lines.zh: : 那我再给她打个电话，说我现在好了。

lines.zh: 大概行吧。你多久能到我家？

lines.zh: : 我可以……带一套我以前的万圣节服装？

lines.zh: 就这样，半个小时过去了，我坐在那儿胡扯着我记得的《蝇王》里的全部内容。

lines.en: Without books or...any actual material to use though, it seems more like the world’s most boring open discussion than actual tutoring. And it’s clear that even Sana’s patience is beginning to wear thin.
lines.zh: 不过没有书，也没有……任何实际材料可用，这看起来更像世界上最无聊的开放式讨论，而不是真正的补课。而且很明显，就连 Sana 的耐心也开始被消磨了。

lines.en: Either that or she’s gotten uncomfortable sitting in a puddle of her own creation by now, infinitely waiting for me to put her out of her misery and hurt her how she wants to be hurt.
lines.zh: 要么就是她坐在自己弄出来的一小滩水渍里已经很不舒服了，无限期地等着我来结束她的煎熬，按她想要的方式伤害她。

lines.en: In a way, I’m thankful that Niki would take it upon herself to wait here and make sure I don’t do that.
lines.zh: 从某个角度说，我挺感激 Niki 会自告奋勇留在这儿，确保我不会那么做。

lines.en: But in another, much darker way, I’ve moved much closer to Sana’s earlier suggestion about tying her up and throwing her into the closet. Or letting her join in.
lines.zh: 但在另一个阴暗得多的角度上，我已经越来越倾向于 Sana 早先那个建议——把她绑起来扔进柜子里。或者让她加入进来。

lines.en: That seems nigh impossible at this point though, if Niki’s trust in me has diminished to the point where she feels uncomfortable just leaving me alone with girls like Sana.
lines.zh: 不过到了这一步，那似乎几乎不可能了——如果 Niki 对我的信任已经低到，光是把我单独留给 Sana 这样的女孩都会让她觉得不安。

lines.en: Is that my fault for how I handled Niki’s initial arrival? Probably. But I feel like some of the blame has to lie with Sana too because of how cute she is.
lines.zh: 这怪我处理 Niki 刚回来那会儿的方式吗？大概是。但我觉得有一部分责任也得算在 Sana 头上，谁让她这么可爱。

lines.en: Creepy, I know. But you’ve gotten used to that by now. Kind of like how Piggy had to get used to dealing with broken glasses until he was ultimately killed by a boulder.
lines.zh: 很变态，我知道。但你现在早就习惯了。就像 Piggy 不得不习惯戴着碎掉的眼镜过日子，直到最终被一块巨石砸死。

lines.en: I wonder if that will happen to me?
lines.zh: 我好奇那会不会也发生在我身上？

lines.en: I wonder if Sana is the boulder? Because at one point, she was the image of purity to me. There was no one more angelic than her.
lines.zh: 我好奇 Sana 是不是那块巨石？因为曾几何时，她在我眼里就是纯洁的化身。没有谁比她更像天使。

lines.en: But now, here she is — wholeheartedly embracing a facade I forced upon her all because she wants me to force myself on her.
lines.zh: 可现在，她就在眼前——全心全意地拥抱着我强加给她的那副面具，而这一切只是因为她想让我强行占有她。

lines.en: That innocence is gone. She is no longer an angel. She is no longer pure. But it’s quite possible she never was to begin with.
lines.zh: 那份天真已经没了。她不再是天使。她不再纯洁。但很有可能，她从一开始就不是。

lines.en: I just wanted her to be.
lines.zh: 只是我希望她是。

lines.en: Kind of like how Piggy wanted to not be killed by a boulder.
lines.zh: 就像 Piggy 也不想被巨石砸死一样。

lines.en: : ...and for those reasons, I don’t think Jack was all that bad.
lines.zh: : ……基于这些理由，我觉得 Jack 也没那么坏。

lines.en: : I...agree, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我……同意，老师……

lines.en: : And thank you for...summarizing the entire book for me...
lines.zh: : 还有谢谢你……把整本书都给我总结了一遍……

lines.en: : It is at this point that I will begin to break down each and every instance of symbolism from the book using nothing but my memory and superior intellect.
lines.zh: 接下来，我将仅凭记忆和过人的才智，逐一拆解书里每一处象征。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m bored.
lines.zh: : 好了。我听够了。

lines.en: scene sanatutoringlol25
: You two keep doing what you’re doing. I’m going to take a shower.
lines.zh: : 你们俩继续。我去洗个澡。

lines.en: : You’re not worried anymore?
lines.zh: 你不担心了？

lines.en: : It’s become clear to me that between Sana’s lesbianism and your monologue about a bunch of kids trying to form a civilization that no one here is going to be doing anything inappropriate any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我算是看明白了，一边是 Sana 喜欢女生，一边是你关于一群小孩试图建立文明的长篇大论，这里短时间内谁都不可能做什么出格的事。

lines.en: : And also, if I have to listen to you talk about this book for more than another five minutes, I’m going to pass out and miss my dance class tonight.
lines.zh: : 而且，要是再让我听你讲这本书超过五分钟，我就要昏过去了，今晚的舞蹈课也要错过了。

lines.en: : Oh. Okay. Have fun.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧。玩得开心。

lines.en: : Take...your time...
lines.zh: : 慢……慢慢来……

lines.en: : I’ll be...gone soon anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正我……很快也要走了……

lines.en: Niki grabs a change of clothes from my our bedroom before disappearing into the bathroom and turning on the water.
lines.zh: Niki 从我们的卧室拿了套换洗衣物，然后走进浴室，打开了水。

lines.en: scene sanatutoringlol26
The sounds of the shower running quickly turn the otherwise silent house into...
lines.zh: 淋浴的水声很快把这栋原本安静的房子变成了……

lines.en: They...
lines.zh: 它们……

lines.en: Uhh...
The...sounds...
lines.zh: 那些……水声……
